result:
All 31 tests pass. Summary of what was implemented for T2:

- `app/routes_export.py`: new `GET /export` endpoint, registered in `app/main.py`. Authenticates via `HTTPBasic`, validates by calling `login(...)` from `app/auth.py` (401 on `AuthError`), and streams reservations as CSV built with the stdlib `csv` module, with columns taken dynamically from `Reserva.model_fields` (no hardcoded names) and `Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8`.
- `tests/test_export.py`: covers valid credentials + data, empty list (header only), missing credentials, wrong password.

Note: while working, another agent concurrently added mandatory OTP (`X-OTP` header) to all username/password-authenticated endpoints and changed `login()`'s signature to `login(username, password, otp)`, and a separate agent renamed the `fecha` field to `inicio` in the `Reserva` model. I adapted `/export`'s auth check to also require OTP via the existing `otp_header` dependency (consistent with the new repo-wide rule) and updated my test fixtures to the renamed field — the export code itself needed no change for the rename since it derives columns from `Reserva.model_fields`.
